chunks: Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

It is recommended for a man and a woman not to leave Makkah until they purchase dates with a dirham and give them in charity for what may have occurred from them during their ihram and for what occurred in the sanctuary of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.إِحْرَامِهِمَا: their state of ihram during hajj or ‘umrah
key_terms.بِدِرْهَمٍ: with a dirham; specifying the amount used to purchase the dates
key_terms.تَمْرًا: dates, the item to be purchased and given in charity
key_terms.فَيَتَصَدَّقَا: then they should give in charity
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred city from which one should not depart before this act
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: it is recommended; a non-obligatory but meritorious ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended charity before leaving Makkah after ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states a recommended act for both men and women after completing the rites connected to ihram in Makkah. Before departing, they should buy dates with a dirham and give them in charity as expiation for any shortcomings connected to their ihram and their conduct within the sacred precinct.
